notes.title: Update to Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I've just release a small bug-fix update for the game.

-Fixed issues with guests not returning after tournament
-Fixed issues with course editing while playing a duel or tournament
-Fixed an issue where you didn't get your money back when you removed a golf course
-Smaller fixes und improvements

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Jolly Putt Dev Plays - October 11th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Jolly Putt will partake in the Steam Next Fest, so I wanted to show you what it's all about and give you the chance to ask questions.

The game will release 17th of October and there's already a free demo that you can check out.
The stream starts October 11th at around 5pm CET

Hope to see you there,
 Tim

notes.title: Demo available now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm here to tell you about the Jolly Putt Demo. You can download it for free from the Shop Page right now!

Limitations of the demo compared to the full game:
[list]
[*] Custom/Sandbox Mode not available
[*] Only one of five tournaments available (along with only a fifth of the unlockable content)
[*] No Park Expansions available
[/list]

I hope you enjoy playing the demo and I would love to hear your feedback about the game!

Cheers,
 Tim
